batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b Swapnil Singh

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c C Green b GJ Maxwell

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c V Shankar b R Sai Kishore

balls.text: Full toss is high-ish and is pummelled. Sails over midwicket. Miller wants to check if that was over waist-high. Replays confirm it was around thigh-high. So the pulled six that takes GT to 200 is all he'll get
Flat bats the short of lengther towards long-on. Jacks runs in and gets yorked, manages to get the body behind it
Low fully on middle and off, gets on one knee and tries sweeping it. Plinks it along the ground to midwicket

Amazing fielding, Patidar almost pulled off a miracle catch at the cover boundary and ends up saving four He ran about 40 yards to the left, got to it, took the catch and lobbed it back. Fielder running back from the edge of the ring was too far, so he couldn't get near despite the throw traveling some distance.
Perfect middle-stump yorker. Almost nutmegged by Miller, helped along to fine leg.
Another wide yorker misses the mark. Miller is reaching out but he's not going across, which often works against batters in T20s. He swings his bat with one hand but ball's out of reach.
Slower bouncer outside off is pulled along the ground to the left of long-on
Miller makes room and Yash goes full, slow and wide. It's past the tramline, so the batter could afford to leave it despire scurrying across
Very full, thrashed along the ground to long-on
Slips out wide. Siraj is lucky that the yorker didn't land outside the cut strip, DK has to do a lot to stop it
Gets it under the bat. 140ks around fifth stump, Miller was deep in the crease and tried jamming it, ball sneaks further inside
Goes for the pull, misses. This was angling away outside off
Smashed through the line. Siraj doesn't miss the yorker by much, line's in around the stumps and Miller is stable as ever, drives with absolute certainty

Jacks charges across but can't hold on! He went to the left from point or just behind, didn't start quickly but picked up pace. The ball was coming down slowly and he dove but got no hand on it. Siraj is frustrated. Was a full ball outside off, Sudharsan got inside the line and tried slogging across the line, got it up off the edge
Nails the falling ramp! Premeditation from Sudharsan, goes across as the bowler delivered. Siraj was put off enough to deliver a slot ball, it was helped high and fine
Very full and on middle and off. Sudharsan was lodging deep in the crease and had delivered a slingshot. Finds long-on
Lands just in front of the crease around off, driven to deep cover
Wide yorker, all he can do is reach out and squeeze it out towards mid-off
Slower one but Sudharsan dishes out the same treatment. Similar line, one hand came off upon impact. May have been deceived but he went through with the shot and hit the same gap again
On the other side this time. On the short side again, this rises around rib-height. The batter stands tall before swivelling while muscling it between long-on and deep midwicket
Back of length, a bit of width offered. Sudharsan stands tall and carves it over cover.

Dayal can't finish off what was an excellent over till the last ball. Slow into the pitch, line around off, Miller had a heave and directed it behind square. Didn't middle it but ball raced along the ground
Fullish outside off, driven off the inside half of the bat to the left of the bowler
Tries to muscle it but can't middle it. Shortish on fifth, he tried to pull/flat bat it
Length outside off, stabbed to deep point
That ball reminds me of a one from Hazlewood that nicked off Miller. Perfect length, fifth stump, Miller tried to square punch it off the back foot. Gets beaten this time
Free hit is a wide yorker at 136ks. Miller started backing away but had to reach out to try and slap it through cover, looked to have edged it to the keeper.
Shortish into the pitch, miscued pull goes to long-on. Uh oh, Yash has overstepped. Klaxon goes off
Cut hard, finds backward point
Great adjustment from Sudharsan. He made room, maybe to open up the offside, but realised upon seeing a slot ball at the stumps, that he can slug it over long-on.
Almost sidearms a full ball outside off at 100ks, driven to cover
Length on fifth, angling in. 95ks, sits up, slapped off the edge. Goes to backward point
Charges down and thrashed the full, wide ball to cover
Full on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Another short ball. Leg-stump line and it's pulled to deep-backward square. GT take the timeout an over before it became mandatory
Sudharsan brings up fifty. Bumper at 137ks is pulled from just under chest-height. Ball was racing to the left of Maxwell at deep-backward square. Good stop
Too straight, too full, helped away. Maybe he looked for another swinging yorker, missed it and got whipped wide of the keeper
Full and wide, driven to deep cover
Full outside off, driven to cover

Reverse-swings at 140ks to castle Shahrukh. Not a yorker but very full, very little Shahrukh could've done about it. He tried whipping it through midwicket but got nothing on it and fell over. Middle and off were rattled. As sexy as it gets with pace bowling.
Comes down and thrashes it to long-on. Batters went hard but could only get six signles

Surprise ball. Sudharsan missed the mark but got away. Full toss at thigh-height at the body, looked like a yorker that went wrong. Batter tried muscling it across the line, got it to deep-mid but without the timing
Full and wide from around the wicket, Sudharsan tries to tonk it down the ground while on one knee. Misses. Angle and pace did him in there
Wide on a slight back of length, 91ks, slapped to long-off
The wide ball duly follows. On a length, around the offside tramline. Shahrukh waits and forces the cut to deep point. He really has wound himself up while trying to cut hard today
Wide on a length, slapped hard to deep cover
Length outside off, pushed to cover off the back foot
Inside edges a flick onto pad, deflects towards point. Was a fullish ball on fourth
Clips it off the pads towards wide long-on

And the assault continues. This time Shahrukh's in control and brings up his first IPL fifty in style. Just 24 balls. He's given GT the impetus they seemed to be lacking at the end of the powerplay. Nehra is happy with the knock. The ball was slow on the fuller side, got smeared across the line and sailed over long-on
Edged over short third. Hit the outfield, get four stuff. Was a back of lengther around sixth, Shahrukh backed away and slashed with a flat bat.
Bumper just outside off, tries to ramp but it's too high. Wide called
Green looks for the yorker and ends up delivering a shin-high fully on off. Shahrukh was lunging down and pulled himself back to ease the drive down the ground. Mid-off was in and it raced straighter
Full and flat on leg, 89ks, defended pretty much to the bowler's right. Karn scuttles across and unwittingly barges at the non-striker. Can't stop it and they take one
Backs away while driving the length ball on off, off the back foot. Stopped at long-off
Darted on the pads, clipped legside

Shahrukh dances down, stops upon realising he's there to the pitch. He then turns his focus towards reaching it as he had made room and the line was outside off. He managed to get up and under to thrash it over long-off
Slaps the wide full ball to deep cover

How flat can a six be? This one's testing those limits. Sudharsan got on one knee and slog swept the slow legbreak on a full length, angling in at him, it was like he went boating. Just oared it up and over midwicket
Length on leg, tucked gently off the back foot towards deep midwicket, looks for two but the fielder's in too quickly
Cuts the wide ball to deep point

Hooked pretty much. Flat six over backward square. Around a back of length but it might as well be short with Green's height, sits up and comes under chest-height, Shahrukh swivels and forces it with power
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward square
Loses his grip while trying to slug the hard-length ball over long-on, while making room. Gets a leading edge that pops up. Luckily for the batter, it clears backward point running back
Starts with a bumper. Beats the pull, wide not given
Length on leg, clipped to short fine
Wide down leg. Length ball landed outside leg and went further in. Sudharsan tried shovelling it fine but missed it
Wide on a length, cut hard with the spin, to deep point. 86ks
Full on the pads, gets a bit across and swats it along the ground to deep square leg
Slaps it through the off side off the front foot
A bit of spin. Fullish length, leg-stump line and Shahrukh pushed at it with an open face, ball goes off the edge to short third
Pumped down the ground. Lebgbreak was full, Shahrukh saw it yesterday, danced down a step to get to the pitch, made a bit of room to swing straight and hard
Flat on a length, worked down the ground. First timeout will have to be taken now
Not that short but Shahrukh read the length early. He knew Maxwell can only spin it in, as Michael Clarke observes, and pulled it with a bit of a crouch. Races between long-on and cow corner
Length outside off, cut to point
Swept down the ground pretty much! 97ks length ball on a wide line, Shahrukh is on one knee, uses his reach to swipe it with a full follow-through. Cleared long-on with ease
Length on leg, 91ks dart, clipped to deep square leg
Worked to the legside for a single

Pulled hard, races along the turf, Kohli runs to the left from long-on and dives valiantly but also in vain. The ball was dropped a bit short, Sudharsan was ready after the last ball was too far. Good over for GT
Slot ball has been thrashed over midwicket. It was slow and at the stumps, he got on one knee and somewhat swept it 75 metres far
Overpitched around off, driven to long-on
Full on off, 89ks legbreak, pushed to cover
Sharukh pats it towards cover and takes off. Not sure why as Faf was close and swooped in to underarm the ball. Luckily the batter didn't travel too far down and made it back

Drilled hard, hits Shahrukh at the other end. Karn charged to the left and stopped as he found out he didn't have to stopped it. Ball popped towards midwicket. Was a full ball at the stumps that was whipped hard
Sits up better for Shahrukh to crunch it with more power and better connection. Great stop at deep point saves a couple
Wide on a slight back of length, spins in, cut to short third

Green takes a skimmer at long-on, Maxwell takes out Gill in his first over! His veins are popping as he thunders about in celebration. Length ball, drifting away on a wide line, did sit up and Gill tried to forehand-smash it straight. The connection was good, the trajectory was flat. Green charged to the left, tumbled across and held on with both hands. The pace was 94ks if I looked at it right
Wide on a length, cut. Lomror runs to the left from deep point, stops it well and throws it hard.
Wide length ball skids through, Gill shaped to late-dab it but had to withdraw
Slow, straight and at the crease, clipped to long-on
Very full again, nudged to midwicket to retain strike

Dipping slower one outdoes Sudharsan who tried being proactive. Got the back foot out the way before sliding back, but the fifth-stump low fully had his upper body collapse while he clipped it to midwicket
Length on the fuller side. Turned to the leg side

Another slower one, this is too short and sits up for the cut. Just 104ks so Sudharsan, who stood still at the crease till the ball arrived next to him, had to swing with force while carving it through point
Touch back of length, 133ks, around sixth. Underedge off the cut has the ball hit the pitch
Really slow wide ball. Sudharsan takes a step across and lunges while deciding to not play at it
Good stop at short fine by Karn, goes the right and half-stops the ball that was rolling away at pace. Saves three. Was a full ball on leg that was clipped
Full on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Very low full toss. Think that's technically still a yorker. It's on leg, and is clipped to wide mid-on. The arc of the ball looked low, almost like that of a slingy bowler
Overpitched on middle and off, driven to mid-on. Pace now up to 143ks
Better line on this bouncer but too high again. Seemed to have landed much shorter too. Good gas though. Swayed away from the line
Effort bouncer is down leg. Goes high too, let go
Low fully on leg, clipped. Dayal at short 45 is a bit lax ash he ambles to the left to stop the ball. Gets fingers on the ball but it goes to the deep. Siraj not pleased
Flat-batted swat, the swing has a rotational arc but he can't middle it. Was a hard-length ball and went to mid-off
Overpitched on the pads, clipped to deep-backward square
Starts with one down leg. Touch back of length, 127ks and Sudharsan tried to help it fine with a pull. Misses
Pitched right up on a wide line, driven to deep cover
Walks towards the length ball angling towards the channel, tries to whip it away but half-connects. Ball rolls to midwicket
Surprise slowy on leg is overpitched, nudged to deep square leg
Driven on the up, good shot, good stop at cover by Kohli too. Saves three.
Ball zips off a length to hurry Sudharsan. In that 6 to 8 metre zone and skidded to reach the batter at top-of-stump height. One hand came off as he tried to punch it with the full face.
Length on leg, clipped to square leg

Sudharsan seemed to walk too far across but managed to connect with the sweep. He went early and got a full flat ball around off, he committed to the sweep and the ball raced along the turf, in the gap between short fine and backward square
Thumped through extra cover. Sudharsan disrupts the length by dancing down, gets close enough to the pitch to drive the ball from a fifth-stump line. It hovered low and wide to the right of cover
Length on fourth, punched off the back foot to long-off
Flatter this time. 96ks. Fullish on middle and off, driven back to the bowler. Not middled, Gill walks aside and bides time. Not letting the bowler hurry through the over
Length on off, 90ks, whipped off the back-foot with the spin, to long-on
Fuller side of length on off, 90ks, driven to deep extra cover
Good bumper, around that off-stump line. Sudharsan shapes to ramp but lets it go. Karthik is halfway through a jumping jack as he takes it

Collision between batter and bowler, direct hit would've been gone but Kohli missed the stumps at the non-striker's end! Gill took off after punching the fullish ball to mid-off. Siraj, who was slowing down in follow-through, tried to turn back in the last second but lost his balance. Gill was charging and fumbled as he went through. Kohli too charged and threw it fiercely but couldn't connect
Wide and fullish, a bit of swing away at 139ks. Gill stands tall and creams it to cover
Strays on the pads and it's clipped through midwicket. Fullish and Gill eases it into the outffield
Good ball, great shot. Just a defensive punch down the ground, was like a check flick. Played it close to the body too and made the three-quarter-length ball seem like a full one.
Pitched right up on fourth, driven to cover

Saha makes room, Swapnil slows the pace down and has him caught at short third! Saham pre-meditated, made room to open up the off side. He tried to lift the length ball at the stumps over cover but it seemed to keep drifting away from the middle of his bat. One hand came off and he plinked it right up. Dolly for the fielder. RCB strike with spin first up yet again
Gill's clipping this time, mid-on runs to the right and is able to stop it. Fullish again, this was on leg though
Fullish on off, defended to the bowler's left. 88ks
Similar length, line's on middle, Saha gets low and on one knee to sweep it to deep square leg
Overpitched, clipped with ease through wide mid-on. Angled into middle and leg, bowler missing his mark there
Sticks in the pitch first up. Length ball on off, touch shorter maybe (judging by the replay), turns a bit and is tapped to the offside

hundred for Jacks! This is ridiculous hitting, and Kohli's expression at the other end says it all. Jacks get there off just 41 balls, including smashing ten sixes. Out came the across-the-line heave off this full delivery, and the ball flew somewhere between the deep-square or deep-midwicket region
more fun for Jacks! He is on 94 now, one hit away from a hundred. Full again from Rashid, but this one turns away from middle, and is drilled over fine leg
bashed to deep square! Fuller length, and the googly ending on leg, as Jacks had a swing, but the ball came off the inside half of the bat

again goes over deep square! My fingers are paining, but my job role doesn't allow you to assume how this ball went. Rashid bowled short for the third ball in a row, and Jacks pulled again for six more
dumped over deep square leg! Rashid bowls short again, and Jacks clears his front leg to pull that hard and high for another six
bowls short on the stumps, and Kohli pulls to deep square to bring up 500 runs for the season
a yorker which is wide of off. Jacks throws his bat at it, and the ball rolls through to short third for a dot ball after all that mauling

just wide of long-on! We'll surely be going home very early today. And this is six too, with the ball dropping on the rope! Length ball from Mohit, and again a slower ball, as Jacks hoicks across the line

pumped down the ground! Mohit, predictably, bowls at a change of pace again, but Jacks blows it away. The ball is full and just outside off, with Jacks' front leg out of the way in ramming it into the sightcreen
slower ball again, and quite full and wide of off. Jacks slices and it goes very high up, but lands wide of long-off

a high full toss, and six more! This could be called an above-waist no-ball too, as the umpire deliberates. This was angled in, and finished just above his waist outside leg. Swung over short fine leg. In fact, it is called no-ball
just over deep midwicket's head! This is Jacks' fifty too. Another length ball from Mohit, as he went from the back of the hand, and just outside off. Crashed over the rope by Jacks
reads the slower ball, and bam! Swiped to deep square, as the ball is on the shorter side of a length on the stumps. But Jacks is ready, and attacks across the line
full and angled into leg, as Jacks looked to sweep but got a bottom edge to the right of short fine
crunched over deep square! This time Jacks nails the sweep, as he reads this length ball on the stumps, and rams it over the boundary
ahh, four byes for RCB to raise the hundred stand. Fullish length just outside leg, and no turn there. Jacks went sweeping but missed, and so did Saha
on a length around off, and moving away to finish wide of off, as Jacks looked to swat but missed
ahh, a lot slower, and on a length outside leg. Nudged towards deep square as he plays late
swatted over extra cover, as this short ball turns away to finish outside off
belted over wide long-on! This over had gone for only five singles, but Jacks makes up for it in the end. Short ball from Sai on middle and leg, and pulled hard for a big six
this turns away a bit from a fullish length on off, and is hacked wide of long-off
swats this short ball outside off to long-off
tossed up, and slower and fuller on off. Nudged aerially to long-off
on a length on the stumps, and quicker. Punched to long-off
short of a length on off, and swept off the bottom of the bat to deep square. Tewatia dives to his right at square leg, but is beaten
on a length on middle and leg, and whipped to deep midwicket to pinch two there. Great running by the two
much fuller length on leg, and Kohli gets a leading edge to long-off, as he shapes to flick but closes the face of the bat early
looks to clip this length ball, but is hit high on his back leg
another slog sweep, and this is six! He gets the front leg out of the way, and clubs this fullish ball on the stumps to go for a huge six over long-on

ohh, first it seemed like Miller fielded really well, but then the ball rolled away. He dived to his right at deep midwicket, and the ball dropped off his hands to trickle for four after Kohli slog swept
on a length on middle, and turns away to finish outside off. Kohli is beaten in looking to poke at it
short of a length on leg, and he guides this to short third after playing from outside leg
flashed over extra cover! Slower ball from Mohit, but the line is around fifth stump, and it is on a length. Jacks, again, backs away, and goes thrashing through the line
ahh, some extra bounce, as Mohit goes for the bouncer. He bangs it in on middle, with Jacks looking to pull but getting beaten this time
thumped over midwicket! Short of a length from Mohit on leg, and Jacks has made room early. He swings through the line, and the ball crashes over the ropes
skips down, and punches at this shortish ball around off to long-off
on a length on middle and off, and pushed to long-on

four to deep backward point! That is also Kohli's fifty. He made room early, and Rashid went short and wide outside off. Kohli almost had to reach out for the ball to slash away from the body, and though it looked unconvincing initially, the ball was still timed nicely enough
a dipping yorker at the stumps, and heaved off the inside half of the bat to deep square

confident appeal for caught behind by Saha - and then by Rashid - and it is given. But Jacks reviews rather quickly. Short of a length from Rashid, and turning in to end just outside leg. Jacks went for the pull, with the ball not entirely bouncing, and sneaking in past the inside edge. Replays show there is no inside edge there; rather, the ball brushed his thigh pad
slower, and full on middle. Hints to turn in, as it is pushed towards point
tossed up, and dipping on a full length on middle and leg. Swept to fine leg
short of a length just outside off, as he sees the batter make room. Hacked to deep point
angled in, and much fuller on the stumps. Clipped wide of long-on
misfield from Omarzai at deep point, and that is four! Should have been ideally two, as Kohli swatted this short ball away

the ball takes off from his pad, as he looks to sweep again, with the ball being tossed up and dipping outside leg. The ball ended up behind the wicket on the off side, as Jacks actually got an inside edge
goes sweeping at this length ball on middle and leg, but gets it off the bottom of the bat to short fine's left
ahh, gets a bottom edge, which runs to the keeper's left. He went sweeping at this length ball dipping on middle and leg, but the turn away deceived him
ahh, pretty slow and turning away off a full length on leg. Clipped towards deep square
short of a length, and turning into leg. Whipped to deep square
clips this aerially towards deep midwicket, with the ball being full and angling into his pads
pushes at this length ball to long-off
just tucks this full ball on middle to wide of long-on, and they set off for two
on a length on middle and leg, and pushed to long-on to keep ticking
short of a length on the stumps, and pulled to long-on

Half an appeal for lbw by Saha, but it is turned down... and Gill is finally convinced to review! Jacks looked to sweep this full ball dipping on a leg-stump line, and shaping to turn away, but missed. The ball passed the inside edge, with no bat involved. But replays confirm that the ball had pitched outside leg, so GT lose a review
flashed to beat slip! Short of a length on middle and off, and turning away, as Jacks plays uppishly but late
this pops up off his pad, as the ball is full and on leg, with Jacks looking to sweep
slower, and fuller on middle and off. Kohli pushes at this slower ball, and Noor, on trying to throw at the stumps at the non-striker's end, ends up allowing a single
swept to beat short fine leg! The ball races away to the fielder's left, as Kohli gets down to dispatch this tossed-up and full ball on leg
shorter side of a length on middle, and hinting to turn away. Punched to long-on
short of a length, and wide outside off. Left alone, as it shapes away further, and wide called
on a length on the stumps, and he opens his stance up to whip it to deep square and pick up a quick two
slower, and fuller still on middle and off. Pushed to cover
slog swept over long-on! Much fuller length, and angled into off, as Kohli got his front leg out of the way to deposit it for another six
just over a leaping long-off! Miller there jumped, but the ball still went over. Kohli swatted at this shortish ball turning away and ending outside off, playing with a wristy look of it
nearly chipped to cover, as he pushes at this length ball on the stumps
sees Jacks make room, and bowls full and on leg. Jacks sweeps but is beaten, hit on his front leg. The ball rolls away to the off side
slashes this length ball outside off to short third, where Sai dives to his left to keep it to a dot, leaving Kohli thumping his bat on his pad
lofted down the ground, and he holds the pose! Presents the full face of the bat at this length ball on the stumps, and confidently launches at Rashid
on a good length, and around off. Punched to point
flicks this fuller ball around off to wide of long-on
this skids through quicker off a shortish length just outside off. Pushed to cover
this is tossed up, and ends up as a full toss around sixth stump. Jacks lofts over mid-off, and loses his bottom hand, as it isn't entirely timed well
fuller side of a length on the stumps, and clipped towards deep square

taken at deep midwicket! This seemed like a variation from Sai, who also went quicker. The release seemed like that of a wrong 'un for a moment. Anyway, Sai saw du Plessis back away a little, and bowled on a short of a length while angling it into middle and leg. Du Plessis went pulling hard and through the line, but found the man in the deep, who had to move a few steps to his left to take that
makes room, and ends up bunting this length ball angled into middle and leg to extra cover. The ball seems to be gripping off the pitch
slows it down, and goes full on the stumps. Driven down to long-off
short of a length on middle and leg, and pushed to deep midwicket
backs away, and the bowler follows. Goes full and outside leg, which is swept behind square, where Noor dives to his right to keep it to one

scooped over the keeper! Du Plessis helps RCB take 17 off this over. He shaped to play the shot early, and went across the stumps. Seeing the fullish ball on the stumps, he went ahead and chipped for four more
just clears the rope over mid-off! This time he went lofting through the line, with the ball being on a length on off. He cleared his front leg, and launched with the full face of the bat

flung away over wide long-on! This seemed to have come off the inside half of the bat, but it still flew off the bat. Fuller side of a length from Omarzai - and around off - as du Plessis again uses his bottom hand to send it sailing
punches this length ball outside off, but finds cover
on a good length, and angled in to finish just outside off. Tapped to deep third
ahh, again Kohli is beaten against Omarzai. He looks to loft at this length ball around sixth stump, but the ball shapes away to beat the outside edge
whipped over square leg! Another length delivery from Warrier, which pretty much goes on straight off the pitch on middle stump. Du Plessis uses his wrists to deposit it for six
much fuller length, but the line is again around the channel outside off. Driven wide of mid-off with the full face of the bat
the crowd roars as the ball is lofted over mid-on! Kohli picks this length delivery from fifth stump, and even as the bat face slightly closes, the ball still travels nicely for four
another wide, and almost a carbon copy of the one earlier in the over. He angles this in, and the ball lands on a yorker length outside leg. Kohli shapes to clip but is beaten
on a length, and angled in. But the ball lands around off, and is punched to mid-off for a hurried single
well field by Miller at short cover. He dives to his left to keep it down to a single, as du Plessis leans into a drive off this length ball just outside off
a yorker-length ball dipping and landing outside leg at 140kph. Du Plessis looked to whip but missed, and it was called wide
bowls on the fuller side of a length, and goes a bit wide of off. Kohli opens the face of the bat, and slices aerially to deep third
short of a length outside off, and swatted to cover

ohh, four bonus runs for RCB! This is an inswinger, which lands on the shorter side of a length and shapes in to hit du Plessis' pad as he went clipping. The ball rolled away beyond the keeper for four leg byes
runs this length ball outside off down to deep third by opening the face of the bat pretty late
and again! This is some Test-match lines and lengths. Kohli walks down the pitch and goes driving, but the ball is on a good length in the channel, and moves away with some extra bounce
ahh, some movement off the pitch! This one shapes away from a short of a length from around fifth stump, even as it was angled in. Kohli went poking away from his body, but was beaten
on the shorter side of a length just outside off, as Kohli gets across and dabs it down on the pitch with a slightly open face of the bat
